name: trimwrit
description: One plugin: trimwrit, which makes a harness rule earn its place with a test.

plugins.name: trimwrit
plugins.description: A harness rule enters with a test and leaves when the test passes without it.

plugins.name: no-em-dash
plugins.description: Refuses a final message, a file write or a shell write that carries an em dash, an en dash, a figure dash or a horizontal bar. The characters are configurable.

plugins.name: explicit-subagent-model
plugins.description: Refuses an Agent or Task call that names no model, so a subagent never silently inherits whatever /model last set.
